subject: SIG request — build guardrails, commit custody & change approvals
messages:
From: Maria Ortega <maria.ortega@acme-sec.com>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-05-19T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: SIG follow-up: request for technical artifacts (build/CI/change control)

Hi Soojin,

Thanks for the quick intro yesterday. Acme Security is assembling the SIG package for our Q3 assessment and we need a short set of technical artifacts that demonstrate build and change custody controls. At minimum we expect: 

- A short narrative about branch protection and merge approval policy (who can approve, required checks).
- Evidence of commit custody/author identity (signed commits or an audit extract).
- CI gate examples (sample workflow runs showing required checks, e.g., unit tests, SAST, dependency scan).
- Secrets management summary (how ephemeral creds are issued to CI, KMS usage).
- Change ticket and approval linkage (example ticket with merge/rollout evidence).
- Retention window for audit logs and where logs are stored.

Can you provide artifacts or point us to a single package we can download? Deadline is EOD Tuesday (2026-05-25) for inclusion in our packet. If anything is sensitive, a sanitized redacted extract is fine — we only need proof-of-control.

Thanks,
Maria Ortega
Senior Assessor — Acme Security

--
AuditCorp is coordinating collection (controls@auditcorp.com) for the SIG intake.

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Maria Ortega <maria.ortega@acme-sec.com>
Cc: jordan_blake@redwood.ai, kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-05-19T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SIG follow-up: request for technical artifacts (build/CI/change control)

Hi Maria — thanks for the clear list. We can provide a compact package that covers all of the items you listed. High-level plan: 

1) Narrative PDF describing branch protection, required reviewers, and SSO + 2FA enforcement.
2) Commit custody extract (redacted CSV) showing commit hashes, author identity and OIDC-linked GitHub actor.
3) CI run samples (GitHub Actions logs with SAST and dependency-check steps redacted where necessary).
4) Secrets management summary + KMS rotation policy PDF.
5) Example change ticket (SUP-1247) with merge approvals and deployment webhook evidence.
6) Audit log retention statement and pointer to our log bucket.

We plan to sanitize commit email addresses and any customer-identifying paths. Jordan, can you attach the redacted custody extract and a CI-run sample by EOD Monday? Kimberly, can you confirm the exact retention timeframe for the logs so I can include that in the narrative? 

Maria — if that sounds good I will upload everything to a Drive folder and share a secure link (read-only) and a downloadable ZIP containing the redacted artifacts. Happy to do a 20-minute walkthrough after you review the materials. Proposed walkthrough windows: Tue 2026-05-26 09:00-11:00 PT or 14:00-16:00 PT.

Regards,
Soojin Lee
Security & Compliance Program Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: build-guardrails-overview.pdf (will follow), kms-rotation-policy.pdf (will follow)

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.ai, kimberly_park@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-05-20T10:27:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SIG follow-up: request for technical artifacts (build/CI/change control)

Soojin — I ran the export and created a redacted commit custody CSV. Notes:

- commit-custody-redacted.csv contains: commit_hash, short_message, author_ldap_id (redacted), commit_timestamp, signed_flag. We removed full email addresses and file paths.
- CI sample is a truncated GitHub Actions run (ci-logs-sample.txt) that demonstrates the required SAST and dependency-scan steps and the final gate failure/success markers. Sensitive outputs are redacted.
- KMS rotation policy attached (KMS rotations occur quarterly; we rotate primary KEKs on a 90-day cadence; full policy in kms-rotation-policy.pdf).
- Ticket SUP-1247 is the canonical change record for the example rollout; it contains approvals from the release manager and SRE on the merge.

I'll upload the four artifacts to the sandbox Drive folder Soojin creates. I also verified the audit log retention: logs are retained 540 days in our central cloud logging bucket (see retention statement below).

We should be ready to hand-off to Acme once Soojin posts the folder link.

—Jordan
Senior Software Engineer, Release Reliability

On retention: "Audit logs are retained for 540 days in the central logging project with role-based access controls and immutable retention policies. Export snapshots to cold storage occur monthly."

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Maria Ortega <maria.ortega@acme-sec.com>, AuditCorp Controls <controls@auditcorp.com>
Cc: jordan_blake@redwood.ai, kimberly_park@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-05-21T15:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SIG follow-up: request for technical artifacts (build/CI/change control)

Maria / AuditCorp team — we uploaded a concise, redacted artifact bundle to the Drive folder below. The ZIP contains the PDF narrative, the redacted commit custody CSV, a sanitized CI log sample, and the KMS rotation policy. We included a short README that maps each file to the SIG control IDs.

Drive folder (read-only): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcD-build-guardrails
Downloadable bundle: build-guardrails-artifacts-20260521.zip
Contained files:
- build-guardrails-overview.pdf (narrative, branch protection policy, reviewer matrix)
- commit-custody-redacted.csv (proof-of-commit custody, emails redacted)
- ci-logs-sample.txt (truncated GitHub Actions output with SAST and dependency-check steps)
- kms-rotation-policy.pdf (KMS rotation cadence and access control summary)
- README_SIG_mapping.txt (maps artifacts to requested items and shows SUP-1247 linkage)

Per Jordan: audit log retention is 540 days and snapshots are exported monthly to cold storage.

If you want us to redact further or provide additional export formats (evidence in JSONL, or raw logs under NDA), we can do that — please confirm. Would you like to schedule the 20-minute walkthrough? Our availability: Tue 2026-05-26 09:30-10:00 PT (preferred) or 15:00-15:30 PT.

Thanks,
Soojin
Security & Compliance Program Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments (sent): commit-custody-redacted.csv, ci-logs-sample.txt, build-guardrails-overview.pdf, kms-rotation-policy.pdf
